people.imagined: The manor's tea room at dusk. She has just sat a guest down and is pouring the first cup with both hands, voice warm as water, her red robe filling the frame. The second cup waits in the other chamber of the pot.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low lacquer tea table at dusk, she pours tea from a red clay pot with both hands and smiles gently at a guest out of frame. Face: a long, oval, flawless face with high smooth cheekbones, warm amber-brown eyes with long lashes and a still, patient depth, finely arched black brows, a straight slender nose, full lips painted a deep rose and curved in a gracious half smile; the skin is unlined, which is the only strange thing about her; she looks about thirty-eight. Hair: glossy black, piled in a tall coil at the crown and held by three long gold pins each tipped with a tiny red bean carved of coral, a single loose lock at each ear. Body: tall, straight-backed, long-necked, her shoulders relaxed and square, an unhurried grace in every angle. Clothing: a robe of rich red silk in three layers: an inner collar of pale rose, a middle layer of crimson, and an outer robe of deep scarlet with wide sleeves, embroidered all over with tiny red beans in thread of a slightly darker red, so many that they form a texture like grain; a wide sash of dark red brocade. Hands and objects: both hands hold a red clay teapot with two spouts; the left pours a thin amber stream into a white cup; at her throat a single bright red bean on a thin red string. Background: a dim room with paper lanterns in red and rose and a window of dark lattice, blurred. Light: soft warm lantern light from the upper left, red reflected up into her face. Expression: a gracious half smile that stays still, warm eyes that keep their own counsel. A faint green Wood and teal Water hint in the steam. Palette: scarlet, rose, gold, lantern amber.

people.imagined: The back garden at first light, among bean trellises. She stands with shears in hand looking at a person coming up the path the same way she looks at a trellis that needs cutting back, banana-leaf hat low.
people.subject: The moment: standing between two rows of red-bean trellises at dawn with a pair of long shears hanging from one hand, she looks steadily at someone approaching on the path. Face: a thin, plain, weathered face with sharp cheekbones, a long straight nose, narrow brown eyes under straight dark brows that look at things as tasks, a firm thin mouth, a line of soil along one cheek; about forty-five. Hair: black with a few grey threads, in a plain low knot under a wide, conical banana-leaf hat tied under the chin with grey cloth. Body: tall, thin, upright, shoulders square, long forearms roped with muscle. Clothing: a clean grey cotton jacket and trousers, sleeves rolled to the elbow, with a short apron of plain brown canvas tied at the waist by a green cord, soil-darkened at the knees but whole and neat; a single bright red bean on a red string at the throat, tucked half inside the collar. Hands and objects: soil under her fingernails, plainly visible; a pair of long iron shears with bamboo handles in the right hand; a small dried gourd with a stopper hung at her hip; a ring cut from dark wood on the right middle finger. Background: tall bamboo trellises thick with green vines and glossy red-and-black beans, tiny red beads among leaves, a path of wet earth, blurred. Light: cool pearly dawn light from the upper left, dew glittering on the vines. Expression: calm, appraising, unwarm. A faint soft green Wood hint round her hands. Palette: fresh green, bean crimson, ash.

people.imagined: The gracious door of the manor house. A guest has just come through and she stands beaming, laughing, a rose fan half-opened and never opened all the way, deciding with her eyes whether this one will be poured a second cup.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a doorway with a rose silk fan half-open before her face, she laughs warmly at a guest out of frame. Face (most important: round, laughing, and the fan): a round, plump-cheeked, merry face with dimples, bright black eyes crinkled with laughter that look at the guest's hands and purse before the face, a short nose, a small red mouth wide in a laugh, a double chin; about thirty-eight. Hair: black, dressed in a glossy high knot with two red lacquered combs and a spray of tiny red-bean beads on a pin. Body: round, short, soft, with a lively, tilting posture and a wide welcome in the stance. Clothing: a fitted robe of rose-pink silk with a scalloped collar, sleeves wide and trimmed in a band of red, a sash of darker rose tied in a flat bow at the front, a short collar of white lace; a single red bean on a string at her throat. Hands and objects: a rose-silk fan on bamboo ribs held in her right hand, opened only a hand's width so that the ribs show; the left hand outstretched toward the guest, palm up, in welcome; a ring of rose-coloured stone on a finger. Background: a carved red-lacquer doorway with a hanging lantern and the dark of a hall behind, blurred. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, pink on her cheeks. Expression: laughing, welcoming, calculating beneath. A faint teal Water hint in the fan's shadow. Palette: rose, red lacquer, lantern gold.

people.imagined: The garden's poison kitchen at night. He is rendering red beans over a low fire with his toad-skin gloves on, stained teeth bared at the stirring spoon, entirely silent, a squat shape beside the pot.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a low fire stirring a black iron pot with a long wooden spoon, his stained teeth showing in a concentrated grimace. Face (most important: toad-skin gloves and stained teeth): a squat, wide, flat face with a heavy brow, small deep-set black eyes, a flat wide nose, a thick-lipped mouth open to show brown-stained teeth in the concentration of stirring, a stubble of black beard; about forty. Hair: black, cropped short, a strip of red cloth tied round the forehead. Body: short, thick, barrel-chested, heavy-shouldered, sitting low on his heels, utterly still except for the arm. Clothing: a clean grey cotton tunic with sleeves rolled to the elbow and a heavy canvas apron stained dark in blotches, brown trousers, a red bean on a string at the throat; neat despite the stains. Hands and objects: gloves of mottled green-brown toad skin to the elbow, plainly warty; the right holds a long spoon, the left a flat paddle; beside him a row of small clay jars with wax seals and a heap of red-and-black beans. Background: a low stone kitchen with a dark roof, a hanging bunch of dried herbs, wisps of pale vapour, blurred. Light: red firelight from the lower left on the face and gloves, the rest dark. Expression: silent, patient, avaricious. A faint dark green Wood-and-poison hint in the vapour. Palette: toad green-brown, firelight red, black.

people.imagined: A rainy lane in Thu Trì at night. He has just won at dice and is standing a round for the carriers, a coin walking across his knuckles that stops only when he is lying, a lacquer box tucked under his arm.
people.subject: The moment: under a dripping awning at night he walks a coin across the back of his knuckles, grinning broadly at friends out of frame, a lacquer box under his arm. Face: a lean, cheerful, wide-jawed face with a quick easy grin, bright black eyes with crinkles at the corners, a broken nose, a short stubble; rain beads on his forehead; about thirty-five. Hair: black and wet, in a rough knot with a loose tail. Body: wiry, loose-limbed, one hip cocked, the weight relaxed. Clothing: a dark red cotton jacket with a wide stand collar and brass toggles, over a clean grey shirt, with a short oilcloth cape over the shoulders and rolled trousers; a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: a single coin with a square hole travelling over his knuckles, caught in the light; a small red lacquer box with a gold line, tied with red cord, held under the left arm; on the right wrist a leather dice-cup bracelet. Background: a narrow wet lane lit by red paper lanterns, a stall with steaming bowls, a crowd of carriers in straw rain-capes, blurred. Light: red lantern light from the upper left, glistening on wet stone. Expression: bright, generous, a little reckless. A faint teal Water hint in the rain. Palette: lantern red, wet black, brass.

people.imagined: The red-bean garden in the afternoon, a tall man in a gardener's apron, the calluses of a swordsman on his right hand, tying up a bean vine; he has heard a footstep and half-turns with the ease of someone who has made peace.
people.subject: The moment: in a garden he ties a bean vine to a trellis with a strip of grey cloth, then half-turns his head toward a sound with a calm look. Face: a long, tanned, calm face with a high forehead, level steady brown eyes, thick straight brows, a straight nose, a gentle mouth, deep smile lines; a thin scar through the left brow; about forty-five. Hair: black with grey at the sides, in a plain knot with a strip of red cloth, stray hairs sticking out. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, long arms, an easy upright stance of a trained swordsman gone soft at the edges. Clothing: a gardener's apron of undyed linen over a plain grey cotton shirt and trousers, sleeves rolled, a banana-leaf hat hanging on his back; at the throat a red bean on a red string. Hands and objects: the right hand has the hard flat calluses of a sword grip along the palm and fingers, plainly visible against a pale green vine; a long plain sword in a worn black scabbard leans against a trellis post, partly covered by a cloth; the left hand holds the cloth strip. Background: rows of tall trellises heavy with vines, red beans dangling, a low sun, blurred. Light: warm golden afternoon light from the upper left. Expression: content, calm, trusting. A faint red-orange Fire warmth at the sword. Palette: green, bean red, gold.

people.imagined: Night, in the picking shed, no lamp. She is sorting red beans by touch in the dark, ripe from poison, quick and sure, her face turned toward nothing in particular, her hands doing the work.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in the dark sorting red beans between her fingers, her face turned up and still, her hands moving fast. Face (most important: a plain boiled-turnip face and wonderful hands): a round, flat, rather homely face, pale and pocked, with small eyes set wide, a bulbous nose, thick pale brows, a wide mouth in an open calm; about eighteen. Hair: dull brown, in two plain braids tied with grey string. Body: short, round-shouldered, stout, sitting cross-legged, still but for the arms. Clothing: a clean grey cotton jacket and trousers with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a banana-leaf hat on her back, a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: long, slender, beautiful hands, quick as birds, in contrast to the face: one hand holds a bright red bean between two fingers while the other pushes a speckled one aside into a separate heap; two flat baskets in front of her, one full of bright beans and the other of dull ones. Background: a dark shed with open roof beams and a trellis seen outside, blurred, a faint moon. Light: a thin cool moonlight from the upper left lights her hands only. Expression: calm, absorbed, sure. A faint soft green Wood hint round the beans. Palette: bean red, grey, moon blue.

people.imagined: The forest path to the manor at dusk. She scatters a handful of red beans across the path with a quick turn of the wrist, her pocket clicking like a dice cup, so that a stranger will see them and turn back.
people.subject: The moment: on a forest path at dusk she flicks a handful of bright red beans from her open palm across the dirt, looking over her shoulder. Face: a young, bright, alert face with a pointed chin, wide dark eyes, arched brows lifted, a quick small mouth with a secret in it, a scratch on the cheek; about twenty-one. Hair: black, in a long braid with a strip of red cloth, a banana-leaf hat hanging from her neck. Body: slim, quick, light, crouched, ready to spring. Clothing: a clean grey cotton jacket with wide sleeves, short trousers and straw shoes; the right pocket of the jacket is swollen and sags with beans; a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: red beans in the air like droplets of blood, bright against dark earth; the other hand holds a bamboo hairpin needle; at her belt a small leather pouch. A few beans lie already scattered in the dust behind her, and a loose braid-end has caught on a twig; her breath comes quick through a half-smile. Background: a dim forest path of tall trees with a faint mist and a distant lantern light, blurred. Light: low violet dusk from the left, red beans glowing. Expression: brave, secretive, quick. A faint green Wood hint at the beans. Palette: bean red, forest green, dusk violet.

people.imagined: The misty bridge of Yên Kiều, as it vanishes in rain. He sits on the parapet in wet wool, one boot tied on with cord, watching the road and counting what each guest carries, ready to send word.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the stone parapet of a bridge half swallowed by mist, he watches the road with a shifty, intent look, one foot swinging. Face: a thin, sharp, sallow face with quick restless eyes, thin brows, a long nose, a small clever mouth, a cowlick; wet hair plastered to the forehead; about sixteen. Hair: dark brown, wet, a cowlick at the crown. Body: thin, lanky, slouched on the wall, long limbs folded. Clothing: a clean grey wool jacket dark with rain, a rope belt, rolled trousers, one worn leather boot and the other tied on with a cord; a straw hat; a red bean on a thread at the throat. Hands and objects: a short stick of bamboo in his hand, with which he scratches marks on the stone; a bag of dried beans at his hip; a small bell on a string hung from the wall. Background: a stone bridge fading into mist, the dark shape of a traveller on the road far off, tall wet trees, blurred. Light: pale diffuse grey light from the upper left. Expression: shifty, watchful, fickle. A faint teal Water hint in the mist. Palette: mist grey, wet wool brown, a dot of red.

people.imagined: The gracious door, with her patron out of the room. She smiles brilliantly at a guest while tugging her rose cuff, as she does whenever a sentence is not true, without noticing; she is learning whom to smile at.
people.subject: The moment: smiling brilliantly at a guest while her other hand tugs the cuff of her rose silk sleeve. Face: a round, pretty, bright face with large dark eyes with long lashes, arched brows, a button nose, a wide smile of perfect white teeth, dimples; the smile just a shade too wide; about twenty-four. Hair: black, in a high glossy knot with a rose-coloured silk ribbon and one red lacquered comb. Body: soft, plump-armed, graceful, with a slight forward tilt in the hips as she bows. Clothing: a robe of rose-pink silk with wide sleeves and a deeper rose collar, a sash of dark red brocade, the cuff of the left sleeve slightly crumpled where it is tugged; a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: the right hand pinches and tugs the rose cuff of the left sleeve; the left carries a small round tray with a white tea cup, empty; a folded rose-silk fan tucked in the sash. Background: the red lacquer doorway and a hanging lantern, blurred, a table of cups and a pot. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Expression: dazzling, ambitious, false. A faint teal Water hint round the cup. Palette: rose, red, gold.

people.imagined: The manor's front steps. He is proudly counting off his family tree on his fingers and has lost the thread at the fifth name; a heavy jade ring is on his thumb. He is thrilled to be taken in so fast.
people.subject: The moment: standing on stone steps, counting on his fingers with a proud lifted chin, frowning as he loses his place. Face: a long, handsome, haughty, boyish face with a high nose, bright proud brown eyes, straight thick brows, a mouth ready to boast, a pimple on the chin; about seventeen. Hair: black and glossy, in a topknot with a green jade pin. Body: tall, lanky, shoulders back, chin lifted, one foot forward. Clothing: a fine robe of pale green silk with silver thread at the cuffs and a high collar, a belt of green cord with a jade hook, black boots; slightly too grand for the place. Hands and objects: a heavy jade ring far too big worn on the right thumb; the left hand's fingers held up and counted down on the right, four fingers already folded; at his side a slim sword in a green scabbard with a carved bean-shaped guard. The jade ring slips on his thumb as he counts, a few petals cling to his boots, and his ears have gone slightly pink with effort. Background: the red-lacquer gate of a manor and a path of red petals, blurred, a gardener bent over a trellis. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: proud, impatient, brave, a little lost. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: jade green, silver, bean red.

people.imagined: The year 1062, in the hall, at the moment he takes the sword down from its rack. A handsome ambitious man looks over his shoulder with a quick smile, confident, one hand already round the hilt.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A handsome man glances over his shoulder with a confident smile, his hand on the hilt of a sword half drawn from a wall rack. Face: a handsome, lean, smiling face with high cheekbones, bright restless dark eyes, a straight nose, a full mouth in a charming smile, a thin moustache and a short trimmed beard; about thirty-five. Hair: black, tied in a high topknot with a red cord, one lock falling over the brow. Body: tall, slim, broad-shouldered, graceful, dressed for stealth. Clothing: a fine dark-red silk robe with a high collar and black trim, a belt of black leather with a bronze buckle, a short dark cloak over one shoulder; a red bean on a string at his throat. Hands and objects: the right hand grips the hilt of a slender sword with a bright red scabbard, drawn a hand's breadth to show a gleam of steel; the left holds the dark cloak closed; on the wall behind a rack with a second empty bracket. Background: a dim hall of red lacquer pillars and hanging lanterns, blurred. Light: lantern light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: charming, ambitious, faithless. A faint red-orange Fire hint on the blade. Palette: faded crimson, black, old gold.

people.imagined: Night in the gardeners' long house, a qin on her knees. She sings the Thorn and Ink Verses half a tone flat, thinking no one listens, while the gardeners drift to sleep around her and she wonders which would leave.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a mat at night with a qin across her knees, singing softly with her eyes half closed, a few sleepers visible behind her. Face: a calm, pale, oval face with a high forehead, level grey eyes, fine straight brows, a small mouth open softly in song, smooth cool skin; about forty. Hair: black, in a low coil at the nape with a bamboo pin and a red bean on a string woven into it. Body: slender, still, upright, hands moving only at the fingertips. Clothing: a clean grey cotton jacket with wide sleeves and a long skirt, a black sash, a banana-leaf hat hung on the wall behind her; a red bean on a red string at the throat. Hands and objects: a plain dark qin with seven strings laid across her knees, one hand plucking a string; a small clay lamp on the floor beside her; a bundle of thorny vines on a shelf. Background: a long low room with rows of sleeping gardeners wrapped in grey blankets, blurred, a paper window. Light: a small lamp from the lower right, warm on her chin; the rest dim. Expression: calm, steady, remote, slightly worried. A faint soft green Wood hint round the strings. Palette: grey, lamp amber, deep green.

people.imagined: At the gracious door, pouring the second cup, her right side turned to the guest so they will not see the left ear. She watches the cup, smiling, on a nod she has been waiting for.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a lit doorway in profile, her right side turned toward the guest, she lifts a two-chambered clay teapot and pours into a white cup, smiling. Face (most important: the missing left earlobe): a soft, round, pleasant face with warm brown eyes, gently arched brows, a small nose, a small smiling mouth; on the left side the earlobe is plainly gone, a smooth little stump; about forty. Hair: black, in a high smooth knot with a pin of red lacquer, a loose lock over the left ear. Body: plump, graceful, turned side-on, shoulders soft. Clothing: a robe of rose and red silk with a broad sash, wide sleeves tipped back, a small red bean on a string at the throat; a white collar. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the lid of the red clay teapot; the left pours a thin stream into a white cup; a small book bound in red cloth tucked in her sash; a jade pendant on a string. Background: a lacquered red doorway and a lantern, a low table with two cups, blurred. Light: warm lantern light from the right, lighting the unharmed side of the face. Expression: sweet, devoted to the nod, hiding. A faint teal Water hint in the poured stream. Palette: rose, red lacquer, white porcelain.

people.imagined: Night in the sorting shed, her hands held over a lamp flame. She feels nothing; the red on her fingertips never washes out. She glances up because a gardener across the room is looking at her as if he knew her.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a sorting table at night, her hands held out flat over a lamp's flame, she glances up toward a man across the room. Face: a quiet, plain, narrow face with a long nose, thoughtful grey eyes, straight pale brows, a closed patient mouth, a freckle by the lip; about twenty. Hair: light brown, in one braid hanging over the shoulder, a banana-leaf hat on the table. Body: slender, upright, composed, shoulders level. Clothing: a clean grey cotton jacket and trousers, the sleeves rolled, a grey apron, a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: both hands held steady over the lamp flame; the fingertips are stained a deep permanent red like cinnabar, plainly visible, as if dyed; on the table two flat baskets of beans, one red, one dull. Background: a bare shed with a beam roof, a row of baskets, and a dim figure of a tall man in a gardener's apron seen at the far end, blurred. Light: the lamp from the lower left lights her hands and chin. Expression: patient, quiet, curious. A faint soft green Wood hint and red glow at her fingertips. Palette: red, grey, lamp gold.

people.imagined: The gracious door. A guest has stepped in; she is pouring the first cup, weighing the guest with her eyes while her smile comes a beat late; she has learned to smile for a killer and not yet for a pretty one.
people.subject: The moment: at the door she pours the first cup, her eyes weighing the guest up and down while the smile has not yet arrived. Face: a young, pretty, sharp face with large calculating dark eyes, thin arched brows, a straight small nose, a small mouth that smiles slowly, a beat after the eyes; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a high knot with two red lacquered pins, a few loose strands at the nape. Body: slim, upright, careful, the elbows neatly tucked. Clothing: a robe of red and rose silk, fitted, with a white inner collar and a darker sash, a rose fan tucked in the sash; a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: a white porcelain cup held on a little saucer in the left hand; a red clay teapot in the right, pouring a thin amber stream; a small silver ring on the middle finger. A faint flush of heat from the tea warms her cheeks, her sleeves are neatly gathered, and the steam rises in a single straight line past her eyes. Background: a red doorway, a lantern, a low table with a second cup, blurred. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Expression: weighing, ambitious, cool. A faint teal Water hint round the cup. Palette: blush, crimson, pearl-white.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market, a stall under an awning. A buyer in toad-skin gloves offers silver; he covers his gold-edged front tooth with his hand at the price, thinking of what to tell his friend.
people.subject: The moment: at a stall under an awning at night he covers his mouth with his hand when a price is named, a gleam of gold at the fingers. Face (most important: the gold-edged front tooth): a round, honest, pleasant face with a broad nose, friendly brown eyes, thick straight brows, a wide mouth with one front tooth edged in bright gold, showing at the fingers; about twenty-three. Hair: black, in a short topknot under a woven straw hat. Body: stocky, easy, with a carrier's wide strong shoulders. Clothing: a dark-grey cotton jacket with a red cord round the collar, a short oilcloth cape, trousers rolled to the shin, straw shoes; a red bean on a thread at the throat. Hands and objects: the left hand over the mouth, the right holding a small red lacquer box with a gold line, tied with red cord; a heavy carrying yoke leans against the stall. Background: a stall with other lacquer boxes in rows, rain on the awning, a figure with green-brown gloves at the edge, blurred. Light: red lantern light from the upper left, wet gleams. Expression: cautious, generous, uncertain. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: lantern red, wet grey, gold.

people.imagined: The poison kitchen, grinding beans for the pastes with cloth wraps on both hands, smelling of clove from ten paces, and never touching bread bare-handed; he looks up sharply at a sound at the door.
people.subject: The moment: grinding red beans in a stone mortar with both hands wrapped in thick white cloth, looking up sharply at a sound at a door. Face: a lean, careful, pale face with narrow suspicious dark eyes, thin dark brows, a long nose, a tight mouth, a small crease of worry; sweat at the temples; about twenty-eight. Hair: black, tied back under a white cloth wrapped round the head, a few damp strands. Body: lean, wiry, hunched over the stone, shoulders tight. Clothing: a clean grey cotton tunic with sleeves tied back at the wrist with cord, a long canvas apron stained brown, a white cloth tied over the lower face and pulled down to the chin; a red bean on a string at the throat. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped in layers of white cloth, tied at the wrist with red cord, round a heavy stone pestle in a stone mortar full of crushed dark red paste; a row of clay jars and a pile of whole red-and-black beans; a bunch of cloves hung from the belt. Background: a low stone kitchen with a black hearth and hanging herbs, blurred. Light: a red-orange firelight from the lower left. Expression: wary, loyal, paranoid. A faint dark green Wood hint rising from the paste. Palette: bean red, cloth white, soot black.

people.imagined: The door at dusk, between guests. She touches the single red bean knotted at the nape of her neck with a hand, saving it for the guide who drinks one cup a month and never asks for a second.
people.subject: The moment: standing quietly at a doorway between guests, one hand lifted to the back of her neck to touch a thread. Face: a quiet, pale, delicate face with large calm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a small straight nose, a small closed mouth; about twenty-two. Hair: black, in a smooth low coil, with a single bright red bean tied on a thread at the nape where the knot shows. A hair-thread of red wool is wound round the coil. Body: slender, upright, reserved, hands light. Clothing: a robe of soft rose silk with a plain collar and wide sleeves, a sash of dark red brocade, nothing else; the red bean at the nape is the only ornament. Hands and objects: her right hand raised to the thread at her nape; the left holds an empty white cup on a saucer; a folded rose fan in the sash. Background: the red-lacquer doorway and a dusk sky, a lantern lit, a path with a tall shadowy figure walking away, blurred. Light: low violet dusk light from the left, a thin gold lantern edge. The last light of dusk traces the line of her neck and the one red bean at her nape like a drop of blood. Expression: quiet, patient, saving. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: rose, bean red, dusk violet.
